payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate x from 1 upward, checking if x can be formed by assigning cubes to digits via all permutations of cube-to-digit mappings (hardcoded for n≤3), stopping at first failure.
payload.rationale: The solution sequentially tests numbers from 1 upward and for each verifies feasibility by checking all possible assignments of cubes to digit positions, effectively enumerating permutations of cube indices for the required digits.
